subject: English
chapter: Unit 6: Class Discussion / The Talkative Barber
learningObjectives: Understand how to participate in a discussion
Identify traits of talkative vs quiet people
misconceptions: Talking a lot means you are very wise

practiceExercises.question: Why did the Sultan give all his food to the Barber?
practiceExercises.hint: He wanted to get his head shaved quickly.
practiceExercises.explanation: The Sultan was desperate for the Barber to stop talking and finish the work.

flashcards.back: Talking together in a group about a topic
A fault or problem (The Barber called his brothers defective)

revisionNotes: Active listening is part of a good discussion. Arabian Nights is a collection of famous stories.
